_note: Estimates for the customer view until the installer confirms the quote. Installed prices; PV and battery 0% VAT (residential, §12(3) UStG), heat pump incl. 19% VAT. Each key has _low / _high; overriding the main key fixes it. Checked 2026-11-07.

_sources.pv: solarserver.de 2025-09-30: ~10 kW system mean 12,768 EUR (Jan 2025: 14,973); 2026 market data 10 kWp without storage 9,700-14,300 EUR (elektronik-zeit.de); model base + per kWp reproduces 10 kWp = 9,700 / 12,500 / 15,000
_sources.battery: Verbraucherzentrale range 300-700 EUR/kWh incl. installation (via reduco.ai 2026); 10 kWh adds 2,800-3,150 EUR to a 10 kWp bundle (elektronik-zeit.de 2026); system price index 477 EUR/kWh 2025
_sources.wallbox: ADAC: 11 kW wallbox incl. installation 1,200-3,500 EUR
_sources.heatpump: air-water incl. installation: ADAC 20,000-35,000 EUR, Vattenfall 24,300-43,900 EUR, Verbraucherzentrale mean ~36,000 EUR (2025); model gives 10 kW = 21,000 / 31,000 / 42,000
_sources.heatpump_subsidy: KfW 458 base grant 30% of eligible costs, eligible costs capped at 28,000 EUR per home since 2026-07-21; bonuses (speed, income, efficiency) not applied
_sources.feed_in: EEG partial feed-in for systems commissioned from 2026-08: 7.71 ct/kWh up to 10 kWp, ~6.66 ct for the part 10-40 kWp (half-yearly 1% degression from 7.78 / 6.73)
_sources.fuel: gas: BDEW Gaspreisanalyse 08/2026, single-family house 11.93 ct/kWh; heating oil: Destatis July 2026 118.11 EUR/hl excl. VAT ≈ 14 ct/kWh incl. VAT; district heating: BDEW/VKU mean 15.6 ct/kWh, co2online 2026 15-17 ct
